content.heading: Our Initiatives
content.subheading: From nutrition to education, every project transforms lives.

projects.title: Project Poshan
projects.description: Addressing hunger, malnutrition and food insecurity through Dry Ration Kits, Nutritious Cooked Meals, Healthy Snack Kits, and Refreshment Support.

projects.title: Project Gyaan
projects.description: Ensuring inclusive, continuous, quality education for children from marginalized communities through academic and digital learning support.

projects.title: Project Sakhi
projects.description: Empowering women holistically through skill development, livelihood training, hygiene support, and confidence-building at the grassroots level.

projects.title: Project Swasth
projects.description: Promoting preventive healthcare, hygiene awareness, and access to essential health support — including oral health, menstrual hygiene, and medical assistance.

projects.title: Project Pashu
projects.description: Dedicated to the care, protection, and well-being of animals — stray dogs, abandoned cattle, injured animals — with feeding drives, medical support, and community awareness.

projects.title: Project Paryavaran
projects.description: Promoting environmental protection through tree plantation, cleanliness drives, and awareness programs to build a greener and healthier future for all.

content.heading: Your Turn to Lead
content.paragraph: Your support creates opportunities and restores dignity — one life at a time.

content.heading: BEYOND SURVIVAL.
content.paragraph: We don't just provide aid; we build dignity. Radical presence in rural India through direct action.
content.missionText: Restoring dignity via consistent nutrition, quality education, and accessible healthcare. No excuses, only results.

content.heading: About MANN CARE FOUNDATION
content.description: MANN CARE FOUNDATION is a compassionate non-profit committed to transforming lives of women and children from underprivileged and marginalized communities.
content.missionText: Addressing fundamental needs — nutritious food, quality education, menstrual hygiene, and self-reliance.
content.visionText: An inclusive society where every woman is empowered and every child is nourished and educated.
